rules: The app's own name is the hero; the byline is the maker's small signature beneath or beside it.
Visible text, not only metadata: a person can find it without hunting (one tap or scroll from the first screen).
Quieter than the name: about 12px, medium weight, muted colour inherited from the app's own theme (light and dark).
Never inside the app icon, never an advertisement, never a banner or modal.
Mark the element with data-haveanapp so verification can find it in any framework.
Also credit the maker in metadata: <meta name="author" content="HaveAnApp"> and the manifest description ('<App> by HaveAnApp').
